t: This is a bronze statue of Franklin Roosevelt, standing in Grosvenor Square. It was made by the Scottish sculptor Sir William Reid Dick and put up in 1948, and it is now Grade II listed. Roosevelt was the American president from 1933 until his death in 1945, longer than anyone else, guiding his country through the Great Depression and then the Second World War. The square itself only became open to the public after the war, under the Roosevelt Memorial Act of 1946. So the memorial and the open square come from the same moment.
